outcome: length of Neurosurgery High Dependency Unit (NHDU) stay
cohort: 155 patients with severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) admitted to the Neurosurgery High Dependency Unit (NHDU) who underwent a tracheostomy.
finding: Early tracheostomy was significant in shortening the duration on ventilation, reducing the length of NHDU stay and reducing the rate of VAP.
who: patients with severe traumatic brain injury
